The experts supported this: the fine_grained_classifier was confused by the scene (predicting 'washbasin' over 'soap dispenser'), likely due to the dominant, anomalous foreground object. The topology auditor found a coherent mask for the hand/faucet, but this does not negate the semantic/structural absurdity of the object itself. The geometric depth auditor provided stats but could not override the visual evidence of the detached spout. The perceptual quality auditor missed the structural issue because it only looks for graphics-level distortions (noise/blur), which confirms the need to rely on the Router's visual observation for structural logic.
